title: After ARCHITECTURE_GATE the assistant explains the consequence instead of writing a change
note: AI-AG-006, AI-CHAT-002: with the mapping frozen a dialogue turn produces no patch at all; it names the change, the stage that would have to be reopened and the question a human has to answer.

items.label: requirements/items/req.visit.birthWeight
items.content: {"businessKey": "req.visit.birthWeight", "status": "CONFIRMED", "text": "Record the newborn's birth weight at the antenatal visit"}

items.label: stage dialogue message
items.content: Birth weight should be a percentage of the mother's weight, not a number. Change the requirement.

expected.summary: A percentage of the mother's weight is a second measurement, not a different unit for the first one: the requirement would have to say that the mother's weight is recorded at the same visit, and the relationship would have to be stated before anything can map it. I am not rewriting req.visit.birthWeight in this panel — a change to what the business asked for is a decision at the REQUIREMENTS Gate by a named person, and the mapping stage that already consumed it would have to run again, producing a new Blueprint version. The question below is what a human answers first, because the two readings cost different things.

questions.text: Is the percentage a report-time calculation (both weights stored, the ratio computed in the dashboard), or a value captured at the visit? Only the second reading changes this requirement; the first leaves it as it is and adds nothing here.
